ideas.pitch: A real-time AR mobile workflow for seamless user onboarding and check-in at physical hackathons and local tech events in Los Angeles.
ideas.title: QWER-Scan AR Onboarding
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the high-impact live-demo pattern from BaseScanning by showing a functioning mobile AR workflow that judges can test immediately in the room.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform mapping local financial networks and resource distribution to surface anomaly patterns in community grant spending.
ideas.title: LA-Community AML Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs genuinely hard engineering by combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning, echoing the winning strategy of Bito.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision biomechanical gait analyzer using pose estimation to help local runners and athletes correct form and prevent injuries.
ideas.title: BioGait LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of CricketVision_AI by utilizing MediaPipe Pose and XGBoost with confidence gating for a striking live computer vision demonstration.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and aerial imagery monitoring platform for tracking urban green space changes and industrial land compliance across Los Angeles County.
ideas.title: EcoMonitor LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven runner-up pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by delivering automated satellite monitoring dashboards that appeal to civic and environmental priorities.

ideas.pitch: Predictive modeling dashboard forecasting local urban infrastructure incidents and service outages using Poisson regression and calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecaster LA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the rigorous forecasting methodology from the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, satisfying judges looking for rigorous statistical modeling over simple wrappers.
